summary: Per-rater significance scores were stored on 80 more counted records (63 copied from the original blind scoring of the key objectives, 17 scored by two fresh blind AI raters; none needed a third rater), bringing records with stored rater scores to 426 of 627. Over the 627 counted recommendations the significance-weighted share in effect is 17.9 percent against 18.0 percent unweighted, with a bootstrap range of 17.4 to 17.8 percent; weighted progress 30.0 against 29.8 unweighted. Rater agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa, 426 records): reach 0.82, magnitude 0.86, breadth 0.85, fiscal 0.9, composite 0.92. No stage, progress or score on any record changed.
title: Weekly significance recomputation
